name: Preventative maintenance
summary: We inspect and service the parts that wear out (roof, seals, tires, brakes, systems) before they turn into a big repair.
bring: The keys to the unit and any compartment locks
A list of anything that’s been bothering you
Your last service paperwork, if you have it

faq.q: How often should I bring it in?
faq.a: Once a year, and before a long trip. Sealant, seals and bearings wear out whether or not the RV moves.

faq.q: How is this different from the annual inspection?
faq.a: The inspection checks the unit and tells you what needs work. Preventative maintenance also does the work: resealing, adjusting and servicing parts so small problems don’t become big ones.
It depends on the size of the unit and what we find, so we quote after we’ve looked at it.
